offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes therapeutics for people with kidney disease. Sells phosphate binder and iron-based oral drugs to dialysis providers, nephrologists and patients through pharmacies and distributors. Products are made by contract manufacturers and it also earns license revenue from partners.

primary_products.value: oral phosphate binder for chronic kidney disease on dialysis; oral iron replacement for iron deficiency anemia in non-dialysis CKD

customer_segment.value: B2B: dialysis organizations, wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, nephrology practices, licensing partners; B2C: patients with chronic kidney disease who are prescribed the drugs

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription kidney disease drugs sold to dialysis providers, wholesalers and pharmacies; licensing or royalties: license, royalty and milestone revenue from international partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs, develops and markets drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to dialysis providers and distributors

geography_served.value: global: Commercial sales mainly in the US, partners commercialize in Japan, Europe, China and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: kidney disease drugs: phosphate binder, oral iron, and pipeline candidates

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: wholesalers and specialty distributors supplying pharmacies; direct sales: sales force and contracts with large dialysis organizations; partners / resellers: licensees commercializing products outside the US
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs requiring FDA approval and equivalent foreign agency approvals, reimbursement rules

notes: Product mix and partner details based on knowledge that may be dated.
